periods.description: International elite Drag-Ride pilots. In vol-21 Mel represents the group in Ymir, and other members are referenced as guests at Lux and Lisha's wedding.
periods.history: A transnational elite force that fought alongside Lux during the broader conflict.
periods.goals: Maintain international stability and respond to major Drag-Ride threats.
periods.structure: Selected elite pilots from multiple states.
